name: Open / deep ocean
notes: Open and deep ocean: no rooted plants at all; near-empty is correct. The only macroscopic 'vegetation' is drifting pelagic Sargassum rafts in the subtropical gyres (Sargasso Sea) and drift kelp; everything else is phytoplankton, not renderable.
